name: cell_source
notes: identity -- the source is the parameter index

name: param_enum_labels
notes: -> value-label table and count for a parameter; `id 0` special-cases the engine table (stride `0x1c`, clamp 22)

name: grain_engine_reset
notes: zeroes `+0x14A`/`+0x14B` (so an unspecified sample index defaults to **0**) and presets `+0x102 = 0xFF`

name: grain_note_setup
notes: looks the sample up by the index at `engine+0x14B`, caches hash at `+0x13C` and length at `+0x140`

name: sample_engine_render
notes: the `Sample` engine, 3420 bytes. Looks the record up through `sample_record_lookup`, bails on slot `0xFF`, compares the record's hash at `+8` against its cache at `engine+0x84`, then fetches audio via `storage_read_request`. Called from `0x0803097E`

name: sample_playback_caller
notes: the `Sample` engine's path to `sample_record_lookup`; does not gate on the hash, which is why `Sample` played from a hash-less record and the granular engines did not

name: wavetable_engine_render
notes: calls `wavetable_fetch`; table index at `engine+0x50`, destination at `engine+0x68`, the user flag is its last argument

name: HAL_FLASH_Program
notes: `type 2` = word; busy-waits on SR BSY with a 50 s cap

name: HAL_FLASH_Unlock
notes: FLASH base `0x40023C00`; KEYR at `+4`, CR at `+0x10`

name: FTF_wait_timeout_bounded
notes: where every preset write hung before the `0xD7` fix

name: HAL_SAI_Transmit_DMA
notes: reached via `sai_transmit`, which adds `0x88` to reach block A and halves the byte count to items

name: HAL_SAI_Receive_DMA
notes: reached via `sai_receive` on block B at handle `+0x00`

name: param_get_by_id
notes: the getter the modulation path uses

name: seq_automation_track_id
notes: 4 tracks, 64 step records of 16 bytes, page stride `0x412`; `0xffff` = unassigned

name: sai_transmit
notes: adds `0x88` to reach block A, halves `bytes` to items, calls `HAL_SAI_Transmit_DMA` at `0x0801F18C`

name: sai2_blockA_dma_init
notes: DMA2 **stream 4** (`0x40026470`), direction `0x40` mem->periph, into `hdmatx` at handle `+0x70`, NVIC IRQ 60

name: sai2_blockB_dma_init
notes: DMA2 **stream 6** (`0x400264A0`), direction `0` periph->mem, into `hdmarx` at handle `+0x74`, NVIC IRQ 69. This is the audio **input**

name: osc_set_gate
notes: writes **1.0** if `on != 0` else **0.0**, to `[osc->0x5c + 0x828]`; vtable slot 7, pointer at `0x08074D30`

name: osc_render_wrapper
notes: two arms on block size `[r1+0x48]`; `== 32` goes to `0x08030A24`

name: the_only_call_site
notes: `ldr r3,[r3,#28]; blx r3`, then caches the state: `strb r9, [r4+0x42B0]`

name: voice_param_block_copy
notes: copies the 132-byte parameter block from `0x2001D9F0` into each voice, destination advancing by `0x59E4`. `memcpy` at `0x08036FDA` then an unrolled word copy. Parameter[0] of that block is what the audio-in gate at `0x08039A90` tests against 20852. **Mid-function**: inside `FUN_08036B38`, reached from `FUN_08038DF8`

name: audio_system_init
notes: 728 bytes; sets the four voices' sample rate through `vtable[0x30]` at `0x080389B2`, stepping `r7` by `0x5980 + 0x64 = 0x59E4` against a bound of `0x16790` -- which is **4 x `0x59E4`** and is where the voice stride is established in the image

name: audio_dma_arm
notes: starts TX then RX, sets state `2` at `engine+0x17F7E`

name: qspi_read
notes: the read primitive; `wavetable_fetch` pulls 0x400 bytes through it

name: qspi_write
notes: **general** RAM->flash write; computes `0x100 - (addr & 0xFF)` and chunks across 256-byte page boundaries itself

name: qspi_erase_and_write
notes: erases the sector containing `addr & 0xFFFFF000`, then tail-calls `qspi_write`. **Arbitrary address** -- the one call a capture routine needs

name: sample_record
notes: `idx > 127` -> the static empty record; else the RAM table

name: wavetable_audio_write
notes: `(arg + 0xFAF + table*4) * 0x1000`, sets the per-table bit at `obj+0x1C5A`

name: preset_page_load
notes: the load hook `mfrender.py` uses; `r1` is the absolute slot, so hooking it reads Bank Select + PC directly (see FORMATS.md)

name: wavetable_fetch
raw_name: wavetable_fetch(obj, dest, 0x20, table, frame, slot, user)
notes: `addr = (frame + table*0x20) * 0x200`, then `+0xFAF000` or `+0xF6F000` **only if `user`** -- per-table bit in the `ushort` at `obj+0x1c5a` picks which. With `user` clear the base is **0**, which is where the factory wavetable bank lives. Reads 0x400 bytes via `FUN_08044260`

name: storage_read_request
notes: queued/async read. **Bounds-checks hard**: rejects unless `addr > 0x0028_0FFF` and `addr + len <= 0x00F5_1000`, i.e. the flash sample region and nothing else. An SRAM address fails it, which is why no engine can play a sample out of RAM

name: mark_dfu_request
notes: erases flash **sector 2** and rewrites the 512-byte record at `0x08008000` with `0xFFFF`/`0x5A`/`0xA5` at `+0xB0`/`+0xB4`/`+0xB5`

name: sample_boot_scan
notes: builds the in-RAM sample directory by a **linear page sweep** from `0x281000` to `0x00F5_0FFF`, advancing `(size & 0xFFFFF000) + 0x1000` on a hit and one page on a miss. Accepts a record when `record[0]` equals the address it was read from (or the magic `0xFA55AAEF`), `slot != 0xFF`, `size <= 0x177000` and `slot < 0x80`. Entered once; `r0` is `obj + 0x1004`. **Mid-function**: it sits inside `FUN_08045098`, which `main` calls at `0x08024F0C`

name: sample_directory_builder
notes: the PC that writes the in-RAM records; see below

name: sample_table_entry
notes: `idx * 0x18 + base + 0xC` -- a **24-byte-stride table of 128 entries** at `obj+0x1004`

name: usb_midi_unpack
notes: cable must be 0; len rounded to /4; needs >=80 bytes free

name: midi_parser_feed
notes: **hot** — also called with 0 as an idle tick

name: sysex_handler_5D
notes: sample slot prepare (write) -- role vs 0x5A unclear -- role unclear

name: sysex_handler_58
notes: sample audio-block select (write), one per block, chained -- confirmed live

name: sysex_handler_5A
notes: sample slot clear/confirm -- addressing confirmed, role unclear -- role unclear

name: sysex_handler_5C
notes: **UNKNOWN** -- implemented, never observed, no recorded role -- UNKNOWN

name: sysex_handler_59
notes: **UNKNOWN** -- implemented, never observed, no recorded role -- UNKNOWN

name: sysex_handler_55
notes: wavetable waveform-data select (read), lo = frame 0-3 -- confirmed live

name: op_52_byte10_0_arm
notes: stores the record, then page write

name: param_get
notes: global parameter getter keyed on `(module << 8) \| param`; applies the per-parameter scaling code

name: assign_slot_label
notes: draws an assign slot's label; computes the slot's id as `0x902 + slot`, which is what proves parameter ids are `(module << 8) \| param`

name: HAL_PCD_DataOutStageCallback
notes: Arturia's own, not the weak one; re-arms with buffer `0x2001EFEC`, 64 bytes

name: usbd_class_setup
notes: the DFU/vendor class dispatch; see FIRMWARE_UPDATE.md

name: dfu_reboot_poll
notes: if the flag is set: mark flash, 500 ms, clear, `SCB->AIRCR = SYSRESETREQ`, spin

name: the_engine_s_render_vtable_slot_2_of_descriptor_0x080785D8_mov_r9_r1_at_0x0805B22E_so_the_flag_struct_is_its_second_argument
raw_name: the engine's render, vtable slot 2 of descriptor `0x080785D8`; `mov r9, r1` at `0x0805B22E`, so the flag struct is **its second argument**

name: writes_the_gain_to__r0_0x0C
notes: the field whose zero silences the engine

name: speech_formant_caller
notes: per-formant loop; writes a float per record with `str lr,[r0],#24`

name: mov_r9_r2_so_r9_is_the_formant_caller_s_third_argument
raw_name: mov r9, r2` -- so `r9` is the formant caller's **third argument**

name: the_gate
notes: `cmp r9,#0; bne` -- `r9 != 0` selects the utterance path
also: FIRMWARE.md:1456 cmp r9,#0; bne` -- `r9 != 0` takes the utterance path

name: osc_entry
notes: engine object array at `obj+0x6E4`, count at `obj+0x724` (reads 7), selected index at `obj+0x658`

name: blx_r7_the_render_call_with_r1_sp_24
raw_name: blx r7` -- the render call, with `r1 = sp+24

name: matrix_source_label_table
notes: 5 pointers: `CycEnv` `Env` `LFO` `Press` `Key/Arp` -- exactly `MOD_SOURCES` order, and the long names confirm `_MOD_SOURCE_TAG` (`EG1`=CycEnv, `EG2`=Env, `Xpr`=Press, `Key`=Key/Arp)

name: assign_module_mask_0x000e01be
notes: bit `module` set = skipped by the generic assign modulation path; allowed are `VCO` `EG2` `Mat` `Co1`-`Co7`. **Not** an assign whitelist -- see FORMATS.md

name: CIN_length_table
notes: 16 bytes, USB-MIDI code index -> MIDI byte count

name: to__separator
notes: read at `0x08051222`; the assign menu joins source and destination with it, giving the `Press -> Wave` entries seen on the device

name: USB_device_descriptor
notes: VID `0x1C75`, PID **`0x0601`**, bcdUSB `0x0200`, bcdDevice `0x0200`. The bootloader differs only in bcdUSB (`0x0201`); tell the modes apart by `bNumInterfaces` (3 vs 1)

name: USBD_ClassTypeDef_vtable
notes: 14 slots; `Setup` is slot 2. Descriptor getters all return `0x080574B8`

name: engine_vtables
notes: seven, Itanium-ABI, **24 bytes each and the stride IS uniform**, through `0x0807861C`; zero header at `0x08078570`, four virtuals, vptr points at slot 0 = `Init`. `0x080785D8` is Speech, engine **index 5** of the seven. The apparent 0x2C gap before `0x08078604` is five interleaved floats at `0x080785E8` (0, 7.01, 12.01, 19.01, 24.01 — semitone intervals), not an irregular record. Installed as vptrs by `FUN_080359B0`; `Init` called on all seven by `FUN_0805F2C4`. See SPEECH.md

name: MIDI_source_tag
notes: `0x00` USB, `0x80` DIN, `0xFF` idle; every callback bails on `0xFF`

name: LCG_state
notes: changes every call — *not* a data pointer

name: receive_channel_gate
notes: `= 0x200007A8+0x3C`; `0x7F` is omni. Reads `0xFF` under emulation, so this is poked

name: sample_directory
notes: records start at `+0x1010`, 24 bytes each, indexed by SLOT: `{u32 flash addr, u32 size, u16 content hash, 13B name, u8 slot}`; slot `0xFF` = unused. Dumped live 2026-09-11

name: dispatch_state
notes: `+0x2DD` USB enable, `+0x2DE` DIN enable (both non-zero already)

name: audio_engine_object_base
notes: `0x2001B630 - 0x16E00`. Size 92,048 (`0x08038AA8`) = exactly 4 x the `0x59E4` voice stride

name: SAI2_B_RX_buffer
notes: base `+0x192`, 256 bytes. Derived from code; EMULATION.md's matching DMA observation is from an earlier harness, so it corroborates rather than confirms

name: dfu_reboot_requested
notes: set to 1 by class request `0xF2`; the only thing that handler does

name: tick_counter
notes: **its scale changes during boot** -- see below
